_readme: Console captures of the landing (docs/landing-spec.md §7.3), taken by scripts/landing/capture-console.ts in desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 at 2x: on the deployed stage (--target poc) signed in as the synthetic guest-test account after a real run of the guided tour (SC-24), or on the local UI server (--target local) over the deterministic moments of tests/ui-server/moments/, which the landing labels 'Entorno local, agente guionado'. Each entry names the console view, the moment of the world it shows, and what to do before the frame: scroll to a section, pick a mailbox, or keep the guided tour open. Alt texts and captions live in packages/web/src/views/landing/media-copy-*.ts. Kept out of public/ on purpose. An entry with 'pending' names why its view cannot be captured yet: capture-console.ts skips it, and landing:check lists it instead of asking for its picture.

console-simulator.pending: The console's simulator procedures (simulator.*) are not registered in the appRouter yet (routers/index.ts): the view answers 'No encontramos lo que buscabas'. Capture it once they are (WP-33).
